question: What does the idiom ‘To have the last laugh’ mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Succeed eventually**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To have the last laugh"** means to ultimately be successful or win in a situation, especially after others doubted or mocked you. (आखिर में जीतना)

 
 
• **Example:** Everyone thought she wouldn’t succeed, but she had the last laugh when her business became a huge success.
 
 
 
• **Succeed** means to achieve what you set out to do or accomplish a goal. (सफल होना)
 
 
• **Example:** After years of hard work, he finally succeeded in getting his dream job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Succeed eventually**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fail hopelessly** (बुरी तरह असफल होना): To completely and utterly fail at something.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his best efforts, he failed hopelessly at convincing the board to approve his proposal.
 
 
 
• **Be mocked** (मजाक उड़ाया जाना): To be ridiculed or laughed at by others.
 
 
• **Example:** He was mocked by his classmates for his unusual ideas.
 
 
 
• **Stay indifferent** (उदासीन रहना): To remain neutral or unaffected by something.
 
 
• **Example:** She stayed indifferent to the criticism and continued with her work.
 
 

13d:Tb5e,
The correct answer is **Option 3**&am
